newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart cut based on valuation - sources.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart cut based on valuation - sources.

text.p: -- Goldman, Sachs & Co's downgrade of Wal-Mart Stores Inc was based on valuation, market sources said.
-- As earlier reported, Goldman said it downgraded Wal-Mart to market outperform from its recommended list.

-- In a research report, Goldman said its downgrade was based on valuation, market sources said. Wal-Mart's stock has appreciated 22.5 percent year-to-date versus a 13.2 percent increase in the S&P 500.
-- Goldman did not change its estimate for Wal-Mart's earnings to rise to $1.35 a share from $1.19 a year ago, sources said.
-- Goldman analyst George Strachan was not immediately available to comment.
